data.name: Mr. Electric of Dallas
data.address: 8500 N Stemmons Fwy Suite #3024, Dallas, TX 75247

reviews.text:
I hired Mr. Electric to install a NEMA 14-50 outlet (EV charging outlet) less than two feet from my breaker box. The total cost after a $100 military discount was $860.
When I asked about the price, the technician explained it was because an “industrial-grade outlet” had to be used. However, the exact outlet installed typically retails for $45–$60. Even adding reasonable costs for the breaker, wire, junction box, and faceplate, the materials should have been in the $150–$200 range.

That means I

Travis and Darrell came to help me install several light fixtures and look into an issue I had with one area of my house. While here, they found an outlet box that was burned and melted. I will be forever grateful for their persistence in looking into my issue and finding the hidden outlet that could’ve been a fire. They were fast, professional, very respectful, and I highly recommend them.

Kaleb was fantastic and we will be requesting him for all future appointments! Kaleb was scheduled for 2 fan installations and saw we had a chandelier boxed up as well and offered to extend his time to assist with this as well. And thank goodness he did as the install required some attic work we would not have been prepared for. Kaleb went out of his way to educate us as well showing us were future improvements could be made and how all our systems worked. 10/10

Guillermo has been very professional knowledgeable, helpful and kind helping my mom’s electrical issues at our home. We now have a brand new breaker box with labels that’s outside now😃 instead of having it inside the home.
Thank you very much!!

Leaving a 5-star review! Patrick was our technician this summer, and he was outstanding. He was knowledgeable, friendly, patient, and did a phenomenal job correcting electrical issues in our first house and making great improvements that made the house feel new. Additionally, Mr. Electric’s pricing was much fairer than other electricians we solicited bids from, and Patrick was good at explaining all charges. In the end, we feel great about using Mr. Electric, and I cannot recommend Patrick enoug

Caleb was wonderful as well as Dalton. Caleb explained everything so thoroughly and was so respectful and positive throughout a very stressful situation. He was constantly in touch with me and responded immediately whenever I called and needed his help. Both he and Dalton made the experience so much better. I would definitely recommend them.

Couldn’t be happier with the service from Wyatt and Junior. They diagnosed the issue right away, fixed it efficiently, and took the time to walk me through what they did. Their workmanship and professionalism are top-notch. I’ll definitely be using them again for any future electrical needs!

Jayden was outstanding! Professional, efficient and friendly. He replaced a defected light panel and required an outside light that was not connecting properly. He reviewed my internal system and found I needed a surge protector on my junction box. It was all done in a few hours at a reasonable price. I am pleased with response and service!

I just had my Ring transformer replaced. My Electrician's name is David Sandefur, he is so professional. He had to climb around in my attic until he found it and during the process he remained pleasant and patient. It is very clear that David enjoys being an electrician and that he is very knowledgeable. He is definitely an asset to this company and I will definitely use Mr. Electric for any and all future electrical needs. Thank you for treating me like you care about me as a customer.

Guillermo came out in the estimated time window. He did an amazing job showing me what was going on in our home. He was very professional, informative and honest. He took pictures to show us issues we were having and provided us with a variety of quotes.

Jayce Fleming was our technician.  He was great.  Very thorough and knowledgeable.  He answered all my questions and was very patient and thoughtful.
Thanks for the excellent service.
Matt Maberry

Guillermo is very friendly and did a great job for us. We had several things to look at and he checked out each one and explained to us what was going on and what needed to be replaced. He went over pricing very thoroughly before completing the work. He worked efficiently too. We hope we’ll get to work with him again if need be.

Technician Nathan M. came out to assist. He introduced himself & company name, and was friendly & very professional. He explained in detail all what he was going to be checking for,  he made sure I understood the diagnosis, and he answered any/all of the questions that I had. He advised me on the cost of the repairs and any other suggested repairs I maybe needing. He showed Great Customer Service, and I highly recommend this company for any/all of your electrical needs.😎
We had all new fire detectors installed. These guys did a great job, had everything they needed for 8 detectors on the truck. Were very fast and super friendly. Even my doodles loved them.

Ray Bunton was amazing! He can’t out addressed my issues and corrected it in a very timely manner. Even showed me some things that he recommends upgrading to meet today’s standard code. Will definitely recommend him to others! Thank you again.

Carlos was great! He upgraded the lights in my office as well as installed some new ones. Needing to complete the additional treatment rooms within my practice in the future, I’ll definitely be reaching out to Carlos with Mr. Electric again!
Great service and on time. JAKE our service technician was wonderful, kind and friendly and easy to understand. We will be using Mr electric and ask for JAKE.

Mr. Electric is a great, trustworthy company to work with!  I thoroughly enjoy working with Ray.  He understands our needs and is quick to fix or bring our projects to resolution!  We just met Michael today.  He was also a pleasure to work with.  I highly recommend Mr. Electric, Ray, and Michael!!!

Roman and another professional from that company did the work, and I'm so pleased I hired them. And, what an upstanding gentleman Roman is, truly!
He is extremely knowledgeable about how to fix complicated electrical issues. He fixed my lighting - 6 of them needing work. Ensured everything was done correctly, and safely. The apartment now looks fantastic. I love it.

Guillermo helped me fix my home with the outdoor lights and timer. He gave me directions on how to use the timer and made it easy to understand. He also helped me with my son's house lights. He is honest and on time! Mr. Electric is a premium compared to other electricians, but they do the job the right way with no short cuts.

Our technician, Jay Weaver, was fantastic. He was professional, thorough, and did phenomenal work. I’ve used Mr Electric twice now, and both technicians have been 10/10 to work with. Highly recommend.

Travis and Clayton were amazing. We ended up needing to add more outlets throughout our house.  They were very thorough and did such a great job getting the job done for us. They even fixed outlets that were not up to code. Will definitely be working with them again on our next projects.

Kaleb and Mr Electric were great. Kaleb inspected what we thought was the problem and was able to determine that it wasn't the issue. He then found the true issue, gave me a reasonable quote and was able to get the job done quickly and professionally. We will definitely be using Mr Electric for any future electrical repairs that we might have. Thanks Kaleb and Mr Electric

Travis and Patrick were amazing! They took care of me from beginning to end and were quick with the fix. Travis is super informative and walked me through what they did and helped answer all of my questions

Outstanding job with my light fixtures.  It was definitely a demanding job with ceilings as high as 30 feet, however, Rhet and Warren took their time and did the job perfectly.  Would definitely  recommend Mr. Electric.
Patrick was great and even found a big issue that he coordinated with Oncor to fix in the same day! We signed up for the membership plan and will be using Mr. electric from now on. Thank you!

We recently hired Mr. Electric Company (Ray was the specialist) to handle some electrical issues in our home, and I couldn't be more pleased with the results. From start to finish, the experience was professional, efficient. Ray arrived on time, explained the work clearly, and completed everything exactly as promised, taking an extra hour free of charge to finish up the work. Not only was the workmanship top-notch, but they also took great care to keep the workspace clean and safe. He explained

Cody was extremely professional and knowledgeable. He completed the work flawlessly and right on schedule.

I highly recommend Mr. Electric of Dallas for anyone looking for reliable and efficient home electrical services.
Jayce Flaming was very professional and explained the process and what’s needed for the job. He did an excellent job.  Highly recommended.

Dylan and Brody were great! Answered my questions and provided detail so I could be informed on the issue and what the fix would be. Went over the quote with me to make sure I was aware and understood. Would highly recommend Mr Electic and especially technicians Dylan and Brody.
Michael was very professional and insightful with information on our electrical system. Absolutely would call him again for any electrical need.

I received excellent customer service from Aaron and David. They were welcoming, respectful and very skillful. I really appreciate all they did to restore my dad's electricity back to a regulated code.
Guillermo is really helfpul and professional. He helped us with Ev charger install and fixed electrical issue in one of our room. Highly recommend his service!

Once again, our electrical experience with Mr. Electric went perfectly. Our technician, Jayden Fleming arrived this morning and we explained our needs and Jayden knew exactly what we needed and assessed and fixed our issue in a timely manner. He is our technician of choice and call for his services whenever the need arises. Thank you Jayden and Thanks Mr. Electric.

I can’t say enough good things about Mr. Electric. They really worked with me in accommodating my schedule and got someone out quickly. Travis was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable and fast without compromising quality.  They even had their insurance already on file at the condominium which saved another step. Will definitely be booking in the future.

Carlos of Mr. Electric is a very knowledgeable and experienced electrician. I am glad that he is the one who changed my smoke and CO detector. He explained details about the mechanisms of the alarm. i definitely recommend him!

Mr. Electric completed the installation of the outlet for my EV today. Travis was prompt, explained everything that needed to be done, and did excellent work! Not only did he provide a high level of professionalism, his customer service was top notch. He also called attention to a potential issue at the box which might need some attention. I will certainly use them again and recommend them for any electrical needs.

I called Mr. Electric on the recommendation of a neighbor.  I needed the services of an electrician, so I called them. I was so pleased with the completed work and will definitely use them if the need arises again.  Jayden and Rhet were the electricians that came to my home.  They were very professional and knowledgeable, answered all my questions and did a GREATjob!
Great service! Aaron seemed very knowledgable and professional. They knocked out a list of issues as well as installing a Tesla charger. Definitely will use them again!

I had a great experience with Travis Carter, who installed my patio lights and kitchen chandelier.

He was incredibly helpful, friendly, efficient and knowledgeable resolving my issue.He went above and beyond to ensure I was satisfied and understood everything he did.

His customer support was fantastic. Highly recommended!

Aaron Alford and David did phenomenal job diagnosing the issue and figuring out a quick solution. Had an electric breaker catch flame they fixed it and had it going in almost no time. And world class customer service and communication

Guillermo did an excellent job installing a new whole house fan. He had to remove the old one in the attic and then install the one one. He was very efficient and explained the process. He cleaned up afterwards and removed all the debris from the job. Highly recommended.

Mr Ray did a good job on fixing my electrical problems from breaker to the switch . I do appreciate knowing this company with good electrician . Giving me a good advice not to load more appliances and not using extension cord !  Thank you do much for the job well done ! Excellent customer service too!

7/7/25 Travis fixed my latest issue very quickly and efficiently! I couldn't be more pleased!

Travis is very knowledgable and efficient. He is friendly and quick. It was a pleasure doing business with Travis and Mr. Electric.

My tech Carlos Delatorre was professional, knowledgeable, and made quick clean work on both occasions he came out for service.  First repair on some exterior lighting on my older 1950s build home was great and learned alot about the history of the house based on his feedback. Second trip was to install 4 recessed lights over my pool table and he was precise with the lazer and got them perfectly situated.  He was thoughtful enough to add a dimmer switch without a request. Couldn't be happier with
Patric was great. Changed my smoke and gas detectors. Super efficient and friendly. Highly recommend

Responded fast with a commercial inspection request. Did initial walk through for estimate, inspected through out the whole office space, very accommodating and charged a reasonable price. I would recommend.
Dylan and Eric were professional and communicated clearly with us. The job was done quickly and cleanly! Thanks guys!

We had THE BEST experience with Guillermo. He is a friendly and expert electrician who took care of our house - we feel safe and at peace now! He let us know the benefits of the services he was going to provide every step of the way. We recommend Mr. Electric, specifically Guillermo for any and all of your electric needs!

Aaron did an amazing job! He was nice, professional, and helpful throughout the entire process. He did an excellent job installing outlets, switches, and a surge protector, ensuring everything was done neatly and efficiently. He took the time to answer all my questions and made sure everything was working perfectly before he left. I highly recommend Aaron for any electrical work—he’s reliable, skilled, and a pleasure to work with!
